title: pm-dispatch(mailbox): one mailbox PR per seat with a closed doorbell vocabulary; seat-online/offline notices; alternate pick for multi-seat lanes
body:
Fixes #27077
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:信箱 PR 从「每项目一个」改成「每席一个」(`pm:mailbox`+`pinned`,正文首行 `To: LOGIN`),信箱上只允许七种一行式门铃(3 种 Request、4 种 Notify),配四条防刷屏硬规则;坐席发 seat-online、收班发 seat-offline;多席车道按优先序交替取卡;`record-recognisers.mjs` 能读这七键,`mailbox-open.mjs` 开信箱时带 `pinned` 并把 `To:` 写在正文首行。
- 为什么改:只有 PR 评论能唤醒订阅的会话,issue 上写什么都没人醒;之前跨席请求全靠对方下次巡查来「拉」(PR #26766 的契约复审等了 9 小时)。改成每席一个信箱后,席位之间可以互相按门铃「推」,而且铃声只带七种键与编号,不会演变成 AI 互聊。
- 风险与回滚:纯协议文本与两个 PM 脚本,不碰产品包、门禁、workflow、队列守卫;回滚 = revert 本 PR。已测得 `pinned` 标签在本仓并不存在(404),首次开信箱时需要看标签是否落上(见 Acceptance notes)。
- 先看:① `references/project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉(七键与四规则,每行 ≤120 字节);② `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `readMailboxLine`(拒收面:表外键、第二行、超 200 字节);③ `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` 的 `PR_LABELS` 与 `mailboxBody`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` 预期末行 `✓ record-recognisers self-test: 254 cases pass (…)`;`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 预期四个受管文件各自 `headroom 0` 且绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S:席位契约复核 PASS 后入队)。

## What changes

One PR, six files, the four ruled sections A–E of the card:

- **A. One mailbox PR per seat** — `references/project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉: one draft PR per seat on `mailbox/LOGIN`, labels `pm:mailbox` + `pinned`, body first line `To: LOGIN`, opened at seating by `mailbox-open.mjs` and subscribed by the seated session, the seat post's stub pointer line carries its number, never merged, closed at hand-over or account switch with the successor opening a new one.
- **B. The closed doorbell vocabulary** — the same section: the first line of a mailbox comment is one of the seven keys (three `Request:`, four `Notify:`), each key one line with its from → to and when; the four hard rules: one event one line ≤200 bytes keys-and-numbers only, anything outside the table is a half-state; no acknowledgements (the action is the receipt); no re-send and no nagging (the existing escalation rules take over); ≤5 per seat per round, p0 exempt, every send counts against the write pace; a mailbox comment is a colleague's statement, never an authorisation.
- **C. Alternate pick for multi-seat lanes** — `references/execution-duties.md` 〈候选与批次〉, one line beside the take order: seat 1 takes the odd positions, seat 2 the even ones over the lane's total order; `split` is sent only to break the alternation; the claim timestamp stays the tie-breaker. Hot-file serial is untouched (its rule stands at L26 of the same section).
- **D. Online / offline** — `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈座位贴协议〉, two lines: seating sends `seat-online`, the 收班简报 act sends `seat-offline`; a forced takeover's newcomer sends `seat-online` for the walled account (which can write nothing); a Routine seat cannot be woken, so its patrol reads the mailbox (the card's P4, said in the text). `SKILL.md` L74 is corrected to the maintainer's form: seats including triage are resident; an account out of tokens is replaced by one that reopens the seat and its mailbox; the triage seat's default tier and 「裁决归总监席」 stay.
- **E. Recogniser** — `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`: `MAILBOX_KEYS` (the seven templates, spelled exactly as the protocol text prints them), `readMailboxLine(body)` (pure: the first line in, a `read` / `refused` / `unreadable` reading out — kind, key, numbers, head sha, login, lists) and `mailboxEvents(rows)` (each comment stamped with its id, `created_at` and author, plus the half-states by comment id). Exported beside `contractReviewHandoff`; no CLI flag; nothing fetched. ⛔ No gate, workflow or queue guard reads a mailbox — the battery pins that a doorbell comment beside a `## Contract review` record leaves the locator's reading untouched.
- **Tooling** — `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`: sends `pinned` with `pm:mailbox` and `skip-changeset`; writes `To: LOGIN` as the body's first line (the protocol text has said `正文首行 To:` since the mailbox was born, while the tool wrote `Mailbox-of:` — one spelling now, the ruled one) and reads it back for refusal ①; the body names the seven-key rule; the close comment says hand-over or account switch. Refusal ① (one mailbox per login per repo) is unchanged: measured on the seat posts, a login holds one seat at a time and a lane's second seat is a second login, so per-login already equals per-seat — the card's open question answered by measurement, no seat name needed.

- **Companion registration (outside the claim's declared file surface — the gate's own remedy, named here as the bounded in-place rule requires)** — the doorbell battery reads `project-forms.md` to pin the templates, which is a population claim on a governed file, and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` reds a new governed read until it is classified. Three mechanical edits, each the shape the gate prints: the `self-test-reads` declaration line in `record-recognisers.mjs` (line 77); the `declared: true` row for it in `GOVERNED_READ_FLOOR` (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`, with a docblock paragraph); and the ninth line of the live-declaration roster in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` (eight → nine). Measured both ways: before, `check:pm-dispatch-gates` failed 2 of 1935 (`unpinned: record-recognisers.mjs::project-forms.md` and `check:pm-record-recognisers … (silent)`); after, 1935 pass, and `dispatch-gates --commands … project-forms.md` alone derives `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers`, keyed `declared self-test read by scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`. No open PR touches either dispatch-gates file (file scan of the 32 open PRs, 2026-10-28).

Angle-bracket placeholders are spelled `LOGIN` / `N` in this body (the platform strips tag-shaped fragments); the files keep the corpus's `mailbox/<login>` spelling.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `✓ record-recognisers self-test: 254 cases pass` (233 before + the new battery of 21; `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` 13 → 14). The battery reads one example of each of the seven keys (kind, numbers, head sha, login, lists, verdict), pins every template verbatim in `project-forms.md` and that the text lists exactly seven, tolerates the platform's appended footer and key decoration, and refuses: free text, an acknowledgement (`收到,谢谢!`), an empty comment, an eighth key of either kind, a lowercase kind, a line over 200 bytes, a second line of content, and a known key whose line does not spell its template (no head, 6-hex head, bad login, missing mailbox, missing lane, non-numeric record). `mailboxEvents` carries comment id / time / author and lists the half-states by comment id.
- `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `✓ mailbox-open self-test: 45 cases in 8 batteries pass` (two new pins: `pinned` is read off `stale.yml`'s `exempt-pr-labels` and `pm:mailbox` is not in it; the body opens with `To:` and names the closed vocabulary; the open-plan battery floor 8 → 9).
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, 401 cases (it loads the recogniser through the real lazy import).
- No ablation: no tested product behaviour changed (scripts and protocol text — ⛔ 不消融). No package build or `pnpm test` owed: the diff touches no package (`turbo ls` has no root package, so this is 「不在图上」, not 「动不了」).

## Acceptance notes

- **`pinned` does not exist as a label on objectstack-ai/objectstack** — `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/labels/pinned` → 404 on 2026-10-28, and so does `work-in-progress`; of `stale.yml`'s three `exempt-pr-labels` only `security` exists (200). The text makes `pinned` mandatory and the tool sends it, as ruled; whether the relay's labels leg (a POST to the pull's issue-labels path) creates a missing label is a platform reading the first mailbox open takes, not one this PR asserts (a write). `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` is where a label the fleet relies on is created — out of this card's file surface, left for the seat (carrier: seat). Dedupe words: pinned, exempt-pr-labels, stale.yml, work-in-progress.
- **The half-state patrol has no mailbox row.** The text says 「表外即半态」 (as ruled); `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` has no H-row reading a mailbox, and E forbids a gate reading one. The reading a patrol takes is `mailboxEvents(rows).halfStates`; wiring it into the report-only patrol is a follow-up, not a merge condition.
- **`To:` vs `Mailbox-of:`** — the tool's `Mailbox-of:` body line is retired for the protocol's `To:` spelling: 0 `pm:mailbox` PRs are open (measured 2026-10-28), so there is no stored instance to migrate and no dual spelling to keep (创业阶段不渐进).
- **PR #27082 and #26749** both edit `SKILL.md` (L161/L162/L183 and L166) — region-disjoint from L74; neither had landed at `07d18e69` (this branch merged `origin/main` at that sha before opening; the merge brought nothing on this file surface and did not move the lockfile).
- Not filed, noted: the routine line `首次坐席自建本项目的 routine…` (project-forms L31) was kept because its 「分诊席加每小时裸卡轮」 clause has no other home; the 总表 section pays only one line because its `objectstack 置顶 issue「车队总表」` fact has no other home.
